current_coloc_gwas.evidence: The Sei framework was developed for human genetics, evaluated sequence classes against tissue expression and eQTL evidence, and applied them to GWAS interpretation. Project GWAS or eQTL-derived model-selection outcomes therefore belong to a downstream-demo task family, even though project-specific COLOC memberships were not checkpoint targets.

gse281364.evidence: GSE281364 became public on 2026-03-16, nearly five years after the immutable Sei archive. Its HepG2/LX-2 MPRA allele activities and MASLD labels were not checkpoint targets. Reference windows and generic liver, intestine, HepG2, TF, histone, or accessibility profiles may overlap Sei's broad training domain.

gse289173.evidence: GSE289173 became public on 2025-02-12, after the 2021 model archive. Its 48 donor cell states and signed cell-type eQTL/ieQTL outcomes were not checkpoint targets. Reference loci outside chr8/chr9 were eligible for sequence sampling, and the accession-level target alias manifest is incomplete.

gse296875.evidence: GSE296875 became public on 2025-10-01, after the 2021 archive. Its 39-donor same-nucleus RNA/ATAC and QTL outcomes were not targets. The public GEO record describes cardiometabolic liver multiome data but does not provide a MASLD diagnosis or histology phenotype for supervision.

held_out_behavior.donor: Sei has no donor or expression input. At a fixed allele and locus, native predictions are identical across donors. Any fitted target-profile combiner, calibration, enhancer-gene link, or signed-effect head uses donor-grouped development folds.
held_out_behavior.locus: The official training config held chr8 and chr9 for test and chr10 for validation, but all other project loci may have supplied reference-sequence training examples. Project evaluation therefore crosses donor folds with merged chromosome/LD blocks and a 4096-bp boundary buffer; it does not call the encoder locus-clean.
held_out_behavior.sealed: GSE289173 cannot select target profiles, sequence classes, center windows, aggregation, projection normalization, gene links, effect direction, calibration, or thresholds.

interpretation: Sei is target-label-unexposed for GSE281364, GSE289173, and GSE296875 by read-only chronology, replacing the registry's conservative unknown exposure pending this audit. It remains broadly exposed to hg38 sequence and generic liver-related regulatory profiles, and its original official code terms keep it a restricted comparator.

rules.checkpoint_chronology: A project outcome public after the immutable 2021 Zenodo archive is target-label-unexposed unless an upstream target contains the same outcome under an alias.
rules.genome_overlap: Reference-window exposure is distinct from outcome-label exposure and is handled with genomic/LD blocks plus the full input-window boundary buffer.
rules.profile_aliases: The 21907 profile names do not form a complete accession, run, donor, or release manifest. Chronology resolves the three post-2021 project sources, but older source absence cannot be inferred from a missing literal accession.
rules.trans_context: Sei accepts sequence only. Liver/intestine sequence classes and liver-related target profiles are fixed training outputs, not observed donor context.
rules.variant_direction: ALT-minus-REF chromatin or class effects are not signed gene-expression effects without a separately trained and frozen gene/link/direction model.

task_data_gate.gse281364: Retrospective MPRA direction/rank diagnostic only. Locus and class selection must be cross-fitted without held MPRA outcomes.
task_data_gate.gse289173: Eligible for one-time sequence inference only after archive, runtime, and selection locks. The official code path cannot be an open champion.
task_data_gate.gse296875: Eligible for development-only center-bin accessibility classification and fitted feature heads; it cannot make Sei an RNA-conditioned or profile-output model.
